excluded_paragraphs.text: This document summarizes the findings from an online focus group conducted on December 12, 2023, via Zoom.
Participants: A list of participating mindfulness instructors, including their experience and qualifications, is provided [link to list; OSF | List of Participants Focus Group.xlsx].
Discussion Guide: The focus group was guided by a set of questions presented to participants beforehand [link to questions here; OSF | Focus Group Questions.docx].
Key Findings: This document synthesizes the key insights from the focus group discussion.
Transcript: A complete transcript of the focus group discussion is included for further reference.
Key Findings
Key Objectives:
Explore the development of an effective, brief, and accessible mindfulness intervention for individuals with time and financial constraints.
Identify key components for stress reduction within the intervention.
Discuss optimal duration, frequency, and structure of audio mindfulness tracks.
Develop a suitable control group for the research.
Key Discussions and Insights:
Audio Tracks:
Overall, the focus group provided valuable insights into the design and implementation of a self-administered mindfulness intervention. Key considerations included:
Tailoring the intervention to individual needs and preferences.
Balancing structure and flexibility.
Effectively addressing potential challenges such as participant engagement and dropout.
Developing a rigorous and ethical research design.
Conclusion:

The focus group highlighted the need for a brief, impactful intervention that is accessible and scalable. The design should balance scientific rigor with practical implementation, ensuring participant engagement and meaningful stress reduction outcomes.
